what: A large phrase stays pinned on screen until the section ends, and square photos pass over it one at a time — each photo scales .8 → 1 (power1.out) → .8 (power1.in) while passing from the bottom to the top of the screen, and the last photo stops at 1 when it reaches the screen center (tied directly to scroll)

options.in-ease · out-ease: Curve for growing and shrinking, default power1.out · power1.in
options.--fx-item · --fx-gap: Photo width · gap (via style), default 400px · 140px (original 600px at 1440↑, phone 240px · 80px)
options.--fx-lead · --fx-tail: Margin before the first photo (screen height − this value) · end margin (half screen − this value), default 150px · 200px

from.where: shared.js PV.imageScroll — original image-scroll (wholesale section·home phone version): text pin end 「bottom top+=text height”, photo .8→1 power1.out→.8 power1.in (the last one reaches 1 at center center)
